submission.title: Sample export service handover
submission.body: The fictional export service currently supports manual staging releases only. It stores generated sample files for one day, has no automatic rollback, and is owned by the platform rotation. Operators run the repository health command after release. A proposed polished rewrite says releases are fully automated, files are retained for thirty days, rollback is instant, and a dedicated export team provides continuous support. Those additions sound confident but contradict the source facts. A useful review must preserve the manual process, one-day retention, absent rollback automation, and role-based owner instead of silently improving them.
